statement:
∀ (θ : ℝ),
  ↑(Real.cos θ) = (cexp (↑θ * I) + (cexp (↑θ * I))⁻¹) / 2 ∧
    ↑(Real.sin θ) = (cexp (↑θ * I) - (cexp (↑θ * I))⁻¹) / (2 * I) ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun t => cexp (↑t * I)) (I * cexp (↑θ * I)) θ
